plates.reference: Own code graphic: on period paper, the 6-date timeline completes: 1842 (Daniel Colladon guides sunlight inside a curving water fountain in Geneva by total internal reflection) · 1917 (Albert Einstein predicts stimulated emission of radiation in Berlin) · 13 Nov 1957–1958 (Gordon Gould coins 'LASER' in a notarised notebook; Townes & Schawlow publish optical maser theory) · 16 May 1960 (Theodore Maiman fires the first laser using a flashlamp-pumped synthetic pink ruby at Hughes Labs in Malibu) · Jan–Jul 1966 (Charles Kao & George Hockham in Harlow prove <20 dB/km purified silica glass fibres can carry laser communications) · Aug 1970–1987 (Maurer, Keck & Schultz at Corning achieve 17 dB/km fibre, refined to 0.2 dB/km and paired with erbium optical amplifiers to carry 99% of global undersea internet traffic).
